last_batch.research: PubMed E-utilities searches covered 30 fresh fibromyalgia self-management topics, all classified as non-prescription candidates. The final query set returned 170 unique PubMed PMIDs, 170 article IDs requested, 169 fetched article records, and 167 abstracts available for inspection because one requested record was absent from the returned NCBI XML and two fetched records lacked abstracts. Retained numeric intervention-versus-control results or valid relative effects were verified for PMID records: 39805734, 32455853, 26084281, 32544346, 38447497, 41316664, 36097826, 41053520, 34499174, 37727908, 41707793, 37162478, 34151818, 40993446, 32604939, 37698013, 31738014, 34335055, 28192782, 33579615, 28950401, 19608724, 33677113, 22948223, 35631229, and 34681287. Twenty-six PubMed references were added across 26 new entries. New entries cover aerobic and low-intensity exercise, resistance exercise, walking, aquatic exercise, tele-yoga, Pilates, tele-Pilates, cognitive behavioral therapy, the FIBROWALK multicomponent program, pain neuroscience education, patient education, progressive muscle relaxation, laser acupuncture, massage, myofascial release, TENS, wearable TENS, EMG biofeedback, neurofeedback, whole-body vibration, hydrotherapy, spa therapy, weight loss, magnesium, and probiotics. Tai Chi, qigong, and dance topics were linked to existing fibromyalgia evidence entries. Acupressure, heat therapy, vitamin D, and coenzyme Q10 were screened out because the selected PubMed records did not provide a retained topic-specific numeric intervention-versus-control magnitude or valid relative effect. The new subject 신경되먹임 was added to data/kinds.json as care. Twelve new comparison-expression warnings, six new effect-length warnings, and one new line-length warning were fixed; no build errors or legacy warning remained. Three new entries retain an unknown-sample-size warning and nine retain truthful thin-study warnings for small single trials.
